name: Carrión de los Céspedes (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle with its base along the fly and its apex at the hoist, charged with a red cross of Calatrava.
history: Municipal flag of Carrión de los Céspedes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the fly and its apex at the hoist
cross of Calatrava on the triangle
